cards.name: Gangster Footera
cards.caption: Footera Criminalera
cards.flavor: A foot in a cap and gold chain. Steal a Brainrot's 2025 stand-in for Tung Tung Sahur.
cards.art: The original AI image: a giant bare foot in a backwards grey cap, black sunglasses, gold chain and black tracksuit, standing in desert dunes under a blazing sun.

cards.name: Ballerino Lololo
cards.caption: Ballerina's buff brother
cards.flavor: Ballerina Cappuccina's brother in fan lore: a muscular smoothie in a tutu, 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image from @fskacca's first TikTok: a smiling smoothie cup with a bent straw, huge muscular arms and legs and a white tutu, dancing on pointe against a soft grey glow with sparkles and glowing hearts.

cards.name: Trulimero Trulicina
cards.caption: Trulimero trulicina!
cards.flavor: A cat-headed fish on four human legs, a viral TikTok chant from early 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image: a scaly silver fish body with red fins, a tabby cat's head with green eyes and four human legs, striding along a sandy beach by the sea.

cards.name: Spijuniro Golubiro
cards.caption: The government's pigeon
cards.flavor: A spy pigeon narrated in Croatian, TikTok, March 2025. Sports clubs made it a meme.
cards.art: The original AI image (left half of Know Your Meme's header): a pigeon in black sunglasses and a tan trench coat with a film camera round its neck, leaning on a concrete wall.

cards.name: Chicleteira
cards.caption: Chicleteira Bicicleteira!
cards.flavor: Brazilian brainrot by @brainbenderchannel: a gumball machine riding a bicycle, 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image: a red gumball machine with a grinning face in its glass globe of gumballs, pedalling a bicycle down a small-town street.

cards.name: Glorbo Fruttodrillo
cards.caption: Half croc, all watermelon
cards.flavor: A crocodile stuffed into a watermelon, an Italian brainrot TikTok staple of 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image: a smirking crocodile head and scaly legs on a round striped watermelon body, wading in a misty swamp with lily pads and reeds.

cards.name: Tric Trac Baraboom
cards.caption: Tric, trac... BARABOOM!
cards.flavor: A zucchini beast on giant bare feet, one of 2025's early Italian brainrot TikToks.
cards.art: The original AI image: a zucchini-skinned creature with a long snout, beady eyes, leaf ears and enormous human toes, standing in a foggy pine forest.

cards.name: Pot Hotspot
cards.caption: Hotspot bro? Hotspot bro!
cards.flavor: Indonesian TikTok by @dytzz88, March 2025, about the friend who always begs for hotspot.
cards.art: The original AI image: a gaunt skeleton with a smartphone for a head, its screen showing a sad wrinkled face, holding up a second phone with a glowing WiFi sign.

cards.name: Dragon Cannelloni
cards.caption: Al dente and on fire
cards.flavor: Steal a Brainrot's 2025 top secret: a pasta dragon, from the AI meme Cannelloni Dragoni.
cards.art: The Steal a Brainrot in-game model: a blocky golden dragon made of ribbed cannelloni with sauce-red patches, spread wings and a toothy grin, on a dark maroon background.

cards.name: Trippi Troppi
cards.caption: Shrimp body. Cat brain.
cards.flavor: The cat-shrimp of the 'Trippi Troppi' TikTok chant, a core Italian brainrot of 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image: a translucent orange shrimp body with long legs and antennae, topped by a tabby cat's face with golden eyes, swimming underwater among bubbles.

cards.name: Strawberry Elephant
cards.caption: Have a strawberry morning
cards.flavor: A 2007 Worth1000 Photoshop winner, meme'd for years, then Steal a Brainrot's first OG.
cards.art: The original 2007 Photoshop: an elephant with strawberry skin and seeds and a leafy green calyx on its head, standing in a strawberry field. No caption text.

cards.name: Lirilì Larilà
cards.caption: Tick tock, lirilì larilà
cards.flavor: The cactus elephant in sandals, first posted on TikTok by @capybarawt in February 2025.
cards.art: The original AI image: an elephant whose body is a spiny green cactus, wearing brown buckled sandals in the desert, with an alarm clock and hot-air balloons floating in the sky.
